    np.random.seed(42)
    n_samples = 500
    
    # Create sample segments
    segments = ['Young_Professionals', 'Middle_Aged', 'Seniors', 'Students']
    segment_col = np.random.choice(segments, n_samples, p=[0.3, 0.3, 0.2, 0.2])
    
    # Create sample numeric variables
    satisfaction = np.random.normal(7, 2, n_samples).clip(1, 10)
    loyalty_score = np.random.normal(6, 1.5, n_samples).clip(1, 10)
    purchase_frequency = np.random.poisson(3, n_samples)
    spending = np.random.exponential(100, n_samples)
    
    # Add segment-specific patterns
    for segment in segments:
        mask = segment_col == segment
        if segment == 'Young_Professionals':
            satisfaction[mask] += np.random.normal(1, 0.5, mask.sum())
            spending[mask] *= 1.2
        elif segment == 'Seniors':
            loyalty_score[mask] += np.random.normal(0.8, 0.3, mask.sum())
            purchase_frequency[mask] = np.random.poisson(2, mask.sum())
    
    # Create sample categorical variables
    gender = np.random.choice(['Male', 'Female', 'Other'], n_samples, p=[0.48, 0.48, 0.04])
    education = np.random.choice(['High School', 'Bachelor', 'Master', 'PhD'], n_samples, 
                                p=[0.3, 0.4, 0.2, 0.1])
    region = np.random.choice(['North', 'South', 'East', 'West'], n_samples)
    
    # Create DataFrame
    df_sample = pd.DataFrame({
        'respondent_id': range(1, n_samples + 1),
        'segment': segment_col,
        'satisfaction_score': satisfaction.round(1),
        'loyalty_score': loyalty_score.round(1),
        'purchase_frequency': purchase_frequency,
        'avg_spending': spending.round(2),
        'gender': gender,
        'education_level': education,
        'region': region,
        'survey_date': pd.date_range('2023-01-01', periods=n_samples, freq='D'),
        'response_time_minutes': np.random.exponential(15, n_samples).round(1)
    })
    
    print(f"Created sample data with {n_samples} records")
    return df_sample
